# EMF Academy

> Expert resource for EMF radiation safety education, product recommendations, and protection strategies.

EMF Academy, founded by Jaron Tietsort, provides comprehensive guidance on electromagnetic field (EMF) radiation exposure and mitigation. The site combines expert knowledge with curated product recommendations and transparent affiliate partnerships to help users reduce EMF exposure in their daily lives.
